row.team_price_text: Usage-based; product plans (Email paid plans from $15/month)
row.evidence: Bird's 'SSO and provisioning' page documents SAML 2.0/OIDC SSO with default access granted on a member's first SSO sign-in, and tells admins to review memberships separately when someone leaves; no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: MessageBird now trades as Bird (bird.com). Pricing is usage-based per product (free tiers, pay-as-you-go, product plans), not per seat, so per-user fields are null. SSO (SAML 2.0 or OIDC) became available to every organization on 18 September 2026. No SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere in the docs, the docs search or the public OpenAPI spec; the only automation is JIT on first SSO sign-in (default organization/workspace role). Team management is dashboard-only: API keys cannot hold the members scope. Audit log is in the dashboard; no audit-log API endpoint in the public OpenAPI.

limitations.text: No SCIM; SSO only provisions on first sign-in (JIT) and does not deprovision: admins must review memberships and sessions separately when someone leaves.
Team management is dashboard-only; API keys cannot hold the members scope, and the public OpenAPI spec has no member or invitation endpoints.
